body_lead: Hyderabad: Telangana hopes to emerge as a role model for digital governance by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI), quantum computing and blockchain to improve public service delivery, IT and industries minister D Sridhar Babu said on Friday. Addressing a session titled âAgents of Change: AI for Government Services and Climate Resilience' at the India AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, the minister said technology is being positioned as a core transformational tool under the Telangana Rising 2047 vision.
